messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — following the RFC I built a small prototype that decouples region bias from cost penalties in the policy engine. Sharing observations and a proposed rollout plan.

simon: Nice. short tl;dr?

maya: tl;dr: introduce a RegionBiasScore as an independent term, normalize it per-tenant over a sliding window, and combine with cost/latency terms with explicit weights. In sim, reduces cross-region thrash for geo-sensitive tenants; ~+3% token-cost delta overall.

ana: Can you paste the scoring formula you prototyped?

maya: Score = baseScore - alpha*costPenalty - beta*latencyPenalty + gamma*regionBiasNorm
regionBiasNorm = (tenant_region_pref_score - global_region_mean)/stdev_clamped

ryan: ops question: how does this change probe placement? Could end up routing to cold GPUs in preferred region and increase latency variability.

maya: Good catch. Mitigation idea: probe_weight_cap and hotpool_preference when regionBiasNorm is positive above threshold. Also add a warmup penalty for nodes with <X minutes of active allocations.

simon: I'm worried about mixing additive and multiplicative effects (costPenalty is currently multiplicative in some branches). Consider making everything affine: Score = w0 + w1*costTerm + w2*latTerm + w3*regionTerm. That keeps linearity for tuning.

maya: That's reasonable. My proto used mixed terms because it's easier to map to existing impl; I'll refactor to affine linear combination so weights are comparable.

ana: Tests we need: unit tests for normalization edge cases (zero-variance tenants), sim harness across at least 50 tenants with skewed region prefs, perf for KV cache churn, and correctness eval to ensure no hallucination/regression (for rerank customers).

ryan: Ops: add alerts for cost_delta_pct > 5% over 1h and latency_p95 increase > 10%. Also monitor hotpool_ratio and cold_start_rate.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: planned canary -> 5% traffic (eu and na regions) for 24h. Canary job queued by deploy-bot at 6161592700.

maya: Interface changes: policy proto needs optional region_bias_config { weight: float, window_seconds: int, hotpool_threshold: float }. Backwards compatible if omitted (defaults to zero weight).

simon: Make sure the proto change is additive only. Runtime should ignore unknown fields for older clients. Also include a deterministic tie-breaker (route_id hash + epoch) so tests are stable.

ana: Documentation: update runtime docs with scoring diagram, explain normalization and knobs, list recommended defaults per tenancy size. Add migration notes for Dedicated customers.

maya: Telemetry: tag every routing decision with policy_version, region_bias_enabled flag, and region_bias_value. Emit metrics: routing.count_by_policy_version, routing.cost_avg, routing.latency_p95, routing.hotpool_ratio, routing.cold_start_rate.

simon: Are we exposing regionBias to customers? I'd prefer a feature flag + GA later. If exposed, default must be off for existing tenants, opt-in via Console or API param.

ryan: Ops +1 on guarded exposure. Add an automated rollback step in the deploy pipeline if cost delta > configured threshold. Prepare runbook for canary -> scale-up -> rollback.

maya: Rollout plan: sim -> canary 5% (24h) -> canary 20% (12h) with expanded telemetry -> staged 50% (24h) -> GA opt-in for tenants -> GA on by default after 2 weeks if stats OK.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: canary started at 6161592700; canary id=canary-regen-316.

maya: I'll open a follow-up PR with the proto change, code refactor to affine scoring, tests, and sim results. Tagging @simon @ana @ryan for review.

simon: Reviewing now, will leave detailed comments. Two high-level asks: keep weights tunable at runtime and add a fast path for legacy policies to avoid perf regression.

ana: I'll add eval prompts to the eval-suite to catch semantic/regression issues for the top 10 tenant use-cases.

ryan: I've added an ops checklist item to the runbook and wired the alerts to paging if cost spike persists > 15m.

maya: Thanks all — I'll post the PR link and the sim dashboard once CI finishes. Closing thread unless new objections.

simon: Thanks, good progress.

eng-bot: CI: all checks passed for branch r/region-bias-proto at 6161592790.
